description.value: The Canadian Lacrosse Hall of Fame is a non-profit museum chartered in 1964 by the Canadian Lacrosse Association and located in New Westminster, the historic heart of Canadian lacrosse. It preserves artifacts, stories, and records celebrating players, builders, and teams who shaped Canada's national summer sport, with roots tracing back to First Nations origins. Touring cyclists interested in Canadian sports heritage can explore physical and virtual exhibits, inductee galleries, and a comprehensive lacrosse timeline.
